ZWORLD.OtherSetting: Pentra: Z-World and {names} are both active. They are separate settings: enable only one per world.

Survival.Tooltip: Food and water on hand. Eat a Meal rolls it against 1–2; scavenging and Survival Kits raise it.

Meal.Label: Eat a Meal
Meal.Note: Survival Die usage check. Either way, you've eaten today.
Meal.Hint: At least once a day, any time. Today:
Meal.NoFood: {name} has no food left (Survival Die 0). Scavenge or hunt for some.

Starvation.Label: Starvation
Starvation.Note: No meal for {days} day(s). If the Death Die drops, it never comes back.
Starvation.RestNote: Starvation: if you haven't eaten since your last rest, roll the Death Die against 1 to the days gone hungry.

Scavenge.Title: {name} scavenges
Scavenge.Hint: Say what you're looking for, then make a Survival check.
Scavenge.ShortHint: Survival check. Food: d4 Survival Die reward for the party; hunting an animal: d6; a kit's supplies: d4 reward on that kit, up to your Durability Die.
Scavenge.NeedGM: A GM must be connected to share the find with the party; only your own Survival Die is rolled.

Kit.Hint: Once per 10-minute activity: a usage check for the kit, then the Survival Die rises on its maximum.
Kit.None: {name} has no Survival Kit with anything left in it.
Kit.Title: Eating from {kit}

City.DayRest: Hole up and rest all day: recover 2 wounds.
City.More: Also during city downtime: train with Karma (Advance on the Skills tab). No clinics, markets or socializing in Z-World.
